text:
[LSER.14.1] A line's time-model phrase declares over what window
of the slot's history the aggregations apply. Four forms:

| Phrase | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `all_time` | from first observation onward, no forgetting |
| `sliding <dur>` | true sliding window of width `<dur>`: at read time `t`, the half-open interval `(t−<dur>, t]` — a sample exactly `<dur>` old is outside it ([LSIG.2.2.4]) |
| `tumbling <dur>` | non-overlapping consecutive windows of width `<dur>`; aggregations read the **most-recent-completed** window. Refused in this edition ([LSER.14.4.5]) |
| `sample <n>` | uniform random sample of size `n` from the unbounded stream (reservoir; see [LSMP]) |

tla.name: lser_14_1__read_sees_the_window
tla.note: A READ SEES THE WINDOW, within the configs' scope (a width of 2 over a clock of 0..5, three absorptions, a bag of 2): under `all_time` and `sliding` the samples a read sees are exactly the ones the row admits, the half-open boundary reached in the clause's engine (`.probe.boundary`) and the closed one refused (`.teeth.closed`), a query that does not discount refused (`.teeth.stale`). Less than the clause under `sample`: the bag's size and its content before it is full, with the generator's choice left open, so "uniform" is not stated; `tumbling` is refused in this edition and not modelled.
